concept_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a new military focus artwork for the fictional post-apocalyptic Khan army, titled in context "Defense of the Reactor Perimeter". NO text in the image.
Reference 1 is the existing HOI4 focus composition and visual density reference: a compact realistically painted collage with a clear cutout silhouette and transparent surroundings. Reference 2 is the exact costume reference, not a pose to duplicate: charcoal green uniforms, burgundy collars, three horizontal dark steel chest plates, brown leather pouches, worn helmets, black face wraps, AKM rifles with wood furniture.
Create ONE cohesive compact roughly square triangular composition suitable for a focus icon: two Khan soldiers defending a squat brutalist reactor building. Main soldier occupies the right foreground from head to knees, looking vigilantly outward to the left, holding an anatomically correct AKM across his chest in both hands at low ready. A second smaller soldier at left behind a low chipped concrete barricade watches the opposite approach, only upper body visible, helmet and black respirator. Strong readable silhouettes, each hand and weapon clearly separated. The protected reactor building rises centrally behind them: thick concrete armored walls, a distinctive broad cylindrical containment dome, two thick coolant pipes and a heavy sealed door with a small amber radiation trefoil. A red warning beacon and dim warm industrial light pick out the door. This is a working defended facility, NOT a destroyed or exploding reactor.
Emphasize THREE principal shapes: reactor, main guard, low perimeter barricade with second guard. Sparse details, no clutter or tiny army. Oblique front view, dramatic mature military concept art, hand-painted realistic materials and restrained weathering, muted charcoal and warm concrete with burgundy details and amber/red lights. Cool upper rim light ensures dark silhouettes remain readable. The base is only a narrow broken-edged patch of ground under the defensive position, not a huge diorama platform.
Genuine transparent alpha outside the silhouette and through open gaps. All building and weapon extremities contained inside canvas with 6 percent clear margin. No rectangular sky or background, no landscape, no black backdrop, no broad smoke cloud, no opaque vignette, no text, no labels, no frame or badge, no neon magic, no laser rifles, no fantasy armor, no extra fingers, no repeated weapons. It must read clearly at small HOI4 icon size but reward close inspection.

assets.prompt: Extract and reconstruct ONLY the concrete reactor building from this image as one isolated asset. Preserve its broad cylindrical containment dome, front sealed steel door with yellow radiation warning, thick curved coolant pipes with red bands on left, concrete buttresses, red beacon fixture above right, weathered realistic materials and original perspective. Reconstruct lower architecture hidden by men and barriers. No people, guns, foreground barricades, sandbags, insignia from barricade, terrain, backdrop or sky. Building fully within image with transparent margin. Small lamps may be luminous but no broad glow, as light effects will be separate. Genuine transparent alpha outside building, realistic detailed concept art.

Extract ONLY the LARGE FOREGROUND SOLDIER from this image and extend him to full body down to complete boots. Preserve his exact charcoal-green uniform, burgundy collar, three plate segmented chest armor, brown webbing, steel helmet with goggles, black face wrap, face and lighting. Preserve both hands holding the same recognizable AKM diagonally across his chest, wooden stock and foregrip, curved magazine, barrel down to screen-right. Anatomically natural fingers, believable rifle. Add matching dark trousers and worn brown high combat boots in a natural grounded standing stance. Entire figure and entire gun visible with margin. No reactor, barricade, sandbags, ground, backdrop, emblems or extra person. One clean full-body character cutout on genuine transparent background.

Extract ONLY the SMALL SOLDIER AT LEFT BEHIND THE BARRIER in the reference and reconstruct him in full body, separate from all scenery. Dark steel helmet with goggles, black lower face wrap, burgundy collar, charcoal-green field uniform, segmented chest armor, brown straps/pouches. Same head turned toward image-left, watching left approach, both hands naturally holding one wooden AKM pointing left. Natural alert standing stance with slightly bent knees, matching trousers and brown high boots. Enlarge him as sole subject with consistent detail, lighting and realistic texture. Entire body from helmet to boots and full rifle inside canvas. No other soldier, building, barrier, sandbags, floor or background. Clean transparent alpha cutout.

Extract ONLY the LOW CONCRETE BARRICADE AND SANDBAGS from this reference as one isolated prop asset. Reconstruct the parts hidden by both soldiers. Worn chipped precast concrete barriers with a few exposed rebar ends and two low layers of dusty sandbags, three-quarter front view, low and wide silhouette. REMOVE the cream tree insignia AND burgundy stripe completely and replace them with continuous plain weathered gray concrete. No emblem, text, flag, person, weapon, building, lamps or terrain slab. No excessively scattered debris. Keep just a compact defensive barrier group, fully visible, actual transparent background and clean edges.

Create a SEPARATE OVERLAY LIGHT EFFECT matching the warm red-orange warning lamp in this image. ONLY the emitted light, no physical bulb or fixture or building. Small bright amber-red core, localized soft crimson halo, two subtle short horizontal red rays, clean smooth falloff to completely transparent alpha, restrained realistic industrial beacon glow. No white or black background, no checkerboard, no smoke, no person, no scene, no lens circle artifacts, no text. One isolated light effect centered on generous transparent canvas, suitable for placing over the separately extracted reactor beacon.
